label: ANCA-associated vasculitis
summary: Bounded MPO-/PR3-ANCA, neutrophil activation, complement/C5a and renal/pulmonary small-vessel injury map for GPA/MPA, with a separate EGPA eosinophilic branch. Human observations and experimental models remain distinct; excludes drug-induced disease and comprehensive diagnostic or therapy coverage.
query: ((TITLE_ABS:"ANCA-associated vasculitis" OR TITLE_ABS:"antineutrophil cytoplasmic" OR TITLE_ABS:"anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic") AND (TITLE_ABS:complement OR TITLE_ABS:C5a OR TITLE_ABS:"extracellular traps" OR TITLE_ABS:priming)) OR ((TITLE_ABS:"eosinophilic granulomatosis" OR TITLE_ABS:"Churg-Strauss") AND (TITLE_ABS:"extracellular traps" OR TITLE_ABS:degranulation OR TITLE_ABS:"interleukin-5" OR TITLE_ABS:"ANCA status"))
